ghastcaller: A ghast's last scream, hammered flat and given an edge. It still wants to be thrown.
ghast_cannon: Pull the string and a ghast's rage pulls with it. Let go, and it lands somewhere loud.
blazeheart: A blaze rod forged around a heartbeat that never cooled. Wear it and cold stops being your problem.
fusebreaker: Forged by someone who was done flinching at the hiss. The blade does not flinch either.
blast_greaves: The blast goes off. You keep walking.
stormcaller: Raise it in a storm and the lightning starts to line up.
shulker_bulwark: Cut from a shell that never opened for anyone. It will not open for whatever hits you either.
voidpick: Made to dig where the floor ends, and it keeps going.
eye_of_the_deep: The guardian's eye never closed. It only learned to watch for you.
raidbreaker: Every dent is a raid that did not end the way the illagers planned.
gilded_brutebreaker: Piglins loved the gold. The ones who wanted it back learned better.
phantom_wings: Stitched from membranes that never slept. Fly them long enough and neither will you.
hellstorm_bow: Every arrow leaves with a skeleton's rattle. A lot of them leave at once.
marrowsprings: Spring-loaded bone. It remembers how to run.
gelsprings: Slime remembers every bounce, and it wants one more.
venomfang: The spider that grew this fang is long gone. The venom never got the news.
galebreaker: A storm pressed into a head of iron. It lands the way thunder does.
deep_dark_heart: Still beating, slow and cold, from somewhere under the deep dark. Even sculk goes quiet near it.
hexweave_hat: Every stitch is a small curse that happens to be on your side.
nether_star_crown: A dying star, kept bright by whoever dares to wear it.
rotbound_plate: Zombie-green and foul. Nothing that bites it ever bites twice.
ghoulcleaver: The butcher's last cut was a good one. The blade has kept going.
witherbane: Ground from a wither's own bones and edged for the thing that keeps coming back.
worldbreaker: The ground flinches a moment before it lands.
green_reaper: Cuts the forest down, and the forest does not seem to mind.
timber_tyrant: Trees do not fall to it so much as kneel.
stormchopper: Lightning has always loved a tall tree. This is how it tells.
yggdrasils_branch: A branch of the world tree, still green at the cut.
pandas_cleaver: Heavy, patient, and made for bamboo or anything else standing.
stemsplitter: The fungal forests grew tall. They did not grow tall enough.
sakura_storm: Blossoms fall in its wake long after the tree is gone.
ironwood_hatchet: It smells of woodsmoke and of every tree it has already taken.
fortunes_favor: It does not find the vein. The vein finds it.
magmaheart: A heartbeat of molten stone, warm enough to soften any wall.
deepdelver: Made for the miner who thinks the next level down is always better.
void_digger: What it digs out of the world does not come back the same.
kings_ransom: Every ore pays tribute to the one who carries it.
starfall: It fell from the sky once. Now it makes the ground pay for that.
world_eater: It does not stop at the surface. It does not stop at all.
geode_heart: Crack the dull shell and the whole cave sparkles.
cinderfang: It bites coal and breathes embers.
kings_excavator: Even the dirt knows whose ground it is.
grave_robber: The dead stay quiet about what is buried with them. It never asks.
fossil_finder: Patient hands, old bones, and a lot of luck.
soul_digger: The sand here still whispers. This shovel listens.
yetis_spade: Carved from a frozen legend, and it has not warmed up since.
swamp_kings_shovel: Mud, moss and a crown nobody dared to take back.
pharaohs_spade: Dry sand keeps its secrets, but never from this.
harvest_moon: Crops lean toward it the way tides lean toward the moon.
reapers_bounty: Something unseen walks the rows beside you and takes the weeds.
golden_harvest: Everything it cuts comes back richer than it left.
chronos_hourglass: A season in a swing. The field never sees it coming.
glowvine_crook: A shepherd's lamp, still glowing with the cave it came from.
blightbloom: Gorgeous, poisonous, and not the least bit sorry.
edens_promise: Wherever it passes, the soil remembers being a garden.
florists_folly: Petals follow it everywhere, and so do the bees.
leaf_blower: It clears the canopy in one gust and leaves autumn behind.
shroom_boom: Spores, a pop, and a very loud cap.
warpbloom_sickle: Cuts the Nether's strange gardens and comes back with more.
farmers_overalls: Patched a hundred times. Every pocket is deeper than it looks.
kings_shears: A gilded pair for the one flock that answers to a crown.
frostbite: One cut and the wool turns brittle with cold.
phoenix_shears: The sheep burn, shed, and walk away with fresh wool.
golden_udder: The one cow in the herd that was never ordinary.
beastmasters_bounty: Animals walk toward the holder of this leash as if they had decided to.
queens_decree: Say it once and the hive is yours.
shepherds_chain: One call, and the whole flock turns toward you.
cluckmasters_hoe: The coop goes quiet when it walks in.
centaurs_saddle: Half horse, all the glory, none of the reins.
hiros_spirit: For Hiro, a very good boy, who is still right beside you.
leviathans_call: The deep answers when you ask it nicely, and louder when you don't.
gilded_hook: The fish take one look at the gold and bite.
davy_jones_debt: The sea always collects, and this is its receipt.
rainbows_end: There was a pot of gold. The line has been pulling it up ever since.
abyssal_hook: Something far below has noticed the line. It bites back.
prometheus: Fire, stolen once, and never given back.
fortunes_compass: It points toward whatever you need most, not what you want.
tidal_crown: Worn once by whoever ruled the tide. The tide remembers.
alchemists_fortune: Every brew comes out a little stronger than it should.
hells_crucible: What burns goes in. Something better comes out.
relic_seekers_brush: Patience uncovers kings, and sand holds the rest.
lamplighters_lens: The glitter is always somewhere. This shows you where.
beanstalk_boots: Fee, fi, fo, up. The ground falls away a little more each step.
crown_of_the_deep: Heavy is the head beneath the waves, and calm the sea around it.
nomads_mantle: It has seen every horizon and wants to see the next.
magma_walker: The lava learned to hold still for whoever wears these.
phantom_treads: They leave no sound, no print, and no explanation.
greedy_greaves: Loot drifts toward whoever stands still long enough to deserve it.
wardens_visage: Wear the Warden's face and the dark stops hiding things from you.
farmers_hat: Scares crows. Reassures crops. Intimidates nobody else.
enders_embrace: It is hard to hit something that is only half here.
gravewalkers: Walk long enough and the grave starts walking with you.
merchants_gloves: Every handshake is a deal, and every deal tilts your way.
yetis_snowshoes: Snow turns into a road wherever these touch down.
leviathans_fins: Swim like the sea owes you a head start.
lumberjacks_flannel: Warm, red and a little too confident in the woods.
stonecutters_apron: Dusty, stained, and tougher than the stone it keeps off you.
beekeepers_veil: The bees know you now, and they do not mind.
parrots_perch: Someone is always on your shoulder, and they are always right.
nine_lives: Count them carefully. You only get nine.
cinder_sandals: Hot feet, cool head, and a trail of embers behind.
thunderhide: Hit it and the sky hits back.
ender_dragons_elytra: The dragon fell. The sky it ruled has been waiting for a rider ever since.
emberwing: Stitched from a ghast's last cry and a spark that would not go out.
galewing: It does not ride the wind. It argues with it, and wins.
tidecaller_wings: Even the sky remembers the sea, and these wings carry its rain.
sages_puppyfang: Set with Sage's puppy teeth. She never let go of a good fight, and neither does this.
packleaders_mantle: Where the leader walks, the pack walks louder.
woolbound_dream: Count sheep until the day rolls over, and wake up as if it never wore you down.
voidpocket_shulker: A pocket of the End. Whatever you put in is a little safer than you are.
emberlocker_shulker: Warm to the touch, and warmer when the lid lifts.
deepcurrent_shulker: Salt on the hinges. Treasure on the tide.
hoarders_shulker: There is always room for one more thing. Always.
featherlight_shulker: It carries a house and weighs about as much as a thought.
nightpocket_shulker: The dark inside is patient, and it lends you its eyes.
rotbolt_repeater: Every bolt carries a little of the grave. The ones it hits start to smell like it.
tideshot_arbalest: Waterlogged wood that never dries. Neither does anything it hits.
rattlebolt_repeater: It rattles when it is loaded. It rattles louder when it is firing at you.
witherfang_crossbow: Black bone and a cold that hums. What it wounds keeps withering after the bolt is gone.
blastbolt_arbalest: Every bolt has a short, patient fuse. Stand further back than you think.
venomweb_crossbow: Strung with silk that has never snapped. What it catches stays caught.
hexbolt_crossbow: Every bolt is a small curse with feathers. It always seems to know who you were thinking of.
riftbolt_crossbow: It never quite points where you aimed. The bolt gets there anyway.
hellfire_repeater: Stoked with a blaze's heartbeat. Press the power key and it spits what a ghast would.
piglins_gilded_crossbow: Piglins gilded it themselves. The ones who wanted it back found out how it feels to be paid.
pillagers_doom: Taken off a raid captain who thought he was winning. Now it works for the village.
deepgaze_crossbow: Prismarine that never stopped watching. What it looks at moves slower.
echo_arbalest: Quiet like the deep dark is quiet. Then it speaks, and everything near you is thrown.
witherstar_arbalest: Cut from the thing that wanted to end everything. Now it ends things on your behalf.
slimeslinger_crossbow: Bolts that bounce back. So does the wielder.
nightglide_crossbow: Sleepless for three nights and quiet for three more. Its bolts arrive before the sound does.
windcharge_repeater: Every bolt lands with a gust behind it. Feet leave the ground, yours included.
shulkerbolt_crossbow: Lined with shell that never opened. Its bolts do not fall so much as float after you.
